newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai Metal buying back shares. [CORRECTED 06:19 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Metal buying back shares. [CORRECTED 06:19 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects to make clear that Hyundai Metal is not part of the Hyundai Group as originally stated.)
South Korea's Hyundai Metal Co Ltd said on Monday it would buy back 150,000 common shares on the open market from November 2 to February 1 to boost the share price and stabilise its management stake.
The company currently holds 76,220 shares, or 1.42 percent of Hyundai's share capital. After the buyback Hyundai will hold 4.21 percent, a company statement said.
It said the shares would be bought at the previous day's closing price. Daishin Securities, Chohung Securities, Daewoo Securities and Dong Ah Securities will handle the buyback.
Hyundai's shares rose 170 won to 8,560 in late Monday trading.
